elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
zero, one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten, eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty, number, total
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What is the number? (asking number)
• There are three books (counting objects)
• How many...? (asking quantity)
• Number ten, please (identifying items by number)
• Count from 1 to 20 (counting instruction)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Aim
teacherNotes.content: Th-sounds /θ/ in 'three', 'thirteen'; stress on -teen suffix (/tiːn/) vs -ty suffix (/ti/).

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Th-sounds /θ/ in 'three', 'thirteen'; stress on -teen suffix (/tiːn/) vs -ty suffix (/ti/).

teacherNotes.title: Function-First Grammar Rule
teacherNotes.content: Regular plural formation (noun + '-s' / '-es'). Agreement between cardinal numbers > 1 and plural nouns (one student, two students).

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Regular plural formation (noun + '-s' / '-es'). Agreement between cardinal numbers > 1 and plural nouns (one student, two students).
Examples:

• one book
• two books
• five chairs
• thirteen students
• How many books are there?
• There are ten books.
Reading Dialogue & Script:

Script using target language:
Person A: What is the number?
Person B: There are three books
Listening Comprehension Prompt: Listen to the prompt and confirm understanding.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: Pair roleplay, information gap, and personalized speaking task.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice with your partner: I can understand and give basic numbers from 0 to 20 and count objects.
Short Writing Task (~10%): Write 3-4 sentences in your notebook applying target chunks.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60 min Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up Number Bingo; 10-25m Numbers 0-20 Vocab & Pronunciation; 25-40m Singular/Plural Nouns Grammar; 40-55m Classroom Counting Game; 55-60m Cool-down.

• 90 min Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-25m Number Listening Drills; 25-45m Singular/Plural Grammar; 45-65m Memory Counting Game; 65-85m Short Inventory Text; 85-90m Wrap-up.

• 120 min Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Math Warm-up; 15-40m /θ/ Phonetics & -teen Stress; 40-70m Grammar System; 70-100m Warehouse Inventory Simulation; 100-115m Quantity Notes; 115-120m Summary.
